test_vectors: Empty input list produces a single root with zero slots, including zero path, segment, key, match, and visit budgets.
Zero trie-node budget rejects empty and nonempty inputs with BudgetExhausted, Cursor source, offset zero.
Repeated empty and dollar root paths install separate ascending slots at node zero.
Exact expected graph for book[2].price, book[2].title, book, repeated book[2].price, root, other, and book[0].
Root and prefix terminals coexist with descendants; shared suffixes beneath different parents remain separate.
Sibling order preserves first insertion across mixed keys and indices, including u32::MAX.
Equivalent decoded Unicode, surrogate-pair, and escaped-dot spellings share edges without Unicode normalization.
Empty, control-containing, punctuation, wildcard-looking, and numeric programmatic keys remain literal and distinct from indices.
Compiled paths and selector strings use independent owned copies and outlive modified or dropped input storage.
Current segment and decoded UTF-8 key limits are rechecked, inclusive, and enforce zero bounds.
Typed compilation ignores textual, match, and visit budgets while textual compilation enforces path bytes.
Path limits count duplicates, and node limits count only unique prefixes including the root.
Duplicates remain legal after the trie reaches its exact node budget.
Cursor hard slot ceiling accepts 65536 root slots and rejects 65537 even with a larger caller limit.
Cursor hard node ceiling accepts an iterative 65536-node chain and rejects one more node even with larger caller limits.
Parser errors propagate unchanged, preserving first-error ordering, source, offset, detail, and syntax categories.
Wildcard, filter, recursive-descent, union, and slice extensions stay unsupported; quoted and escaped literals remain valid.
compile_strings parses before compiling and checks the parser path-count budget before malformed input syntax.
String and typed compilation produce identical paths and plans; repeated compilation stays deterministic through 129 sibling insertions.
Deterministic allocation-layout overflow maps to BudgetExhausted without altering existing vector contents.
Bounded geometric reservation accepts its exact logical limit, rejects zero and exhausted bounds, and preserves contents on failure.
